channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Met police launch criminal investigation into Mandelson over Epstein files
item.description: He's accused of leaking market sensitive information to Jeffrey Epstein while he was Business Secretary in 2009 - now Peter Mandelson faces a police investigation on suspicion of misconduct in public office.

item.title: Epstein survivor speaks out after latest files released
item.description: We spoke to Jena Lisa Jones, a survivor of Jeffrey Epstein's abuse. She was just 14-years-old when Epstein assaulted her during a massage at his house in Palm Beach.

item.title: US shoots down Iranian drone ‘aggressively’ approaching aircraft carrier
item.description: US Central Command says an American fighter jet shot down an Iranian drone which was "aggressively" approaching the USS Abraham Lincoln - which has been deployed to the Arabian Sea.

item.title: Scottish Labour vows to ban transgender women from female prisons in Scotland
item.description: The Scottish government has been in court defending its policy of placing some transgender prisoners in female jails.

item.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with ‘record number of missiles’ says Zelenskyy
item.description: A teenage boy and girl have been killed in a Russian attack on the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia. Officials said many others were injured, including three children.

item.title: How UK government has just made student loans more expensive
item.description: Pressure is mounting on the Government over the affordability of student loans, after a decision by Chancellor Rachel Reeves to freeze the earnings threshold where graduates begin repayments.

item.title: Chancellor needs to ‘urgently reverse’ freeze on loans threshold says students union
item.description: We spoke to the president of the National Union of Students Amira Campbell.

item.title: ‘Many red flags’ missed before boy’s school murder say family
item.description: The family of 15-year-old Harvey Willgoose - who was stabbed to death by another pupil at his school in Sheffield - has said his murder was "senseless and avoidable".

item.title: Sannia’s Shop: surviving the ‘ceasefire’ in Lebanon | Documentary
item.description: In the past few days, Israel has bombed two villages in southern Lebanon, saying it warned residents to leave before carrying out strikes on Hezbollah targets.

item.title: Musk creates super company as Space X and xAI combine
item.description: Elon Musk has created the world's most valuable private company - by merging his SpaceX with the artificial intelligence firm - xAI - which he also controls.
